title: Survey launch, halved
instruction: Rewrite the passage below in no more than 50 words. Output only the rewritten passage, nothing else.
source: The survey launch Kittiwake II was delivered to the Moray Firth Hydrographic Office on 14 June 1987 by the yard of Oskar Lindqvist & Sons at Buckie. She carried a Decca Mk 21 receiver, hull number MFH-0412, and was skippered for her first eleven seasons by Teodora Brannigan-Achebe. Her longest survey, 212 nautical miles of the Beauly approaches in 1993, took nineteen days. Laid up in 2004, she was sold to a diving club in Lossiemouth and renamed, though the MFH-0412 plate remains on the wheelhouse.
